steps.title: Block out the back
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as back_shell.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane (here: the back seen from above, Y up the back is Inventor Y). Rectangle 440 x 45. Extrude 680 mm, starting 40 mm above the origin. The origin is the recline pivot.
steps.note: Parts of the back are drawn upright; the assembly tilts the back 12 degrees.

steps.title: Shell it
actions: Click Shell. Remove the front face. Thickness 1.2 mm, Inside. Click OK.
steps.note: A 1.2 mm carbon fibre shell is stiff and very light: under 1 kg.

steps.title: Pivot lugs
actions: Sketch a 6 x 40 rectangle on each side face, from 20 below to 45 above the origin. Extrude Join.
Hole: diameter 12, Through All, on the origin (the recline pivot axis).

steps.title: Recline lever
actions: Sketch a 20 mm wide lever under the shell, 204 mm from the centre, down to 110 mm below the pivot. Extrude 8 mm.
Hole: diameter 8 at 100 mm below the pivot, 15 mm behind it (the recline lock pin). Save.
steps.note: The recline lock pushes on this lever: the back can only move when the lock is released.
